relevance_reason: The abstract describes a large exome/genome sequencing study of consanguineous families with autosomal recessive intellectual disability, but it does not name the MRT37 gene or describe any MRT37 family or variant. The details that matter for this entry are presumably only in the full text, which was not available.

findings.statement: Hu et al. (2019) performed whole exome and whole genome sequencing in 404 consanguineous, predominantly Iranian families with 2 or more affected offspring with intellectual disability. They found likely causative variants in 219 of these families. The variants involved 77 known and 77 novel autosomal recessive intellectual disability (candidate) genes, 21 X-linked genes, and 9 genes previously implicated in diseases other than intellectual disability.
quotes: we report on whole exome and whole genome sequencing in 404 consanguineous predominantly Iranian families with two or more affected offspring
In 219 of these, we found likely causative variants, involving 77 known and 77 novel AR-ID (candidate) genes, 21 X-linked genes, as well as 9 genes previously implicated in diseases other than ID.

relevance_reason: The paper describes a consanguineous family with moderate ID carrying a homozygous truncating ANK3 frameshift mutation (MRT37), together with a translocation patient and a Drosophila model.

findings.statement: Iqbal et al. (2013) described a consanguineous family in which affected members had moderate intellectual disability, an ADHD-like phenotype, and behavioral problems.
quotes: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems, we identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the same gene

findings.statement: In affected members of a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability and an ADHD-like phenotype, Iqbal et al. (2013) identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the ANK3 gene, which the authors stated represented the first reported familial mutation in ANK3.
quotes: we identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the same gene, which represents the first reported familial mutation in the ANK3 gene

variants.as_reported: homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform

findings.statement: Iqbal et al. (2013) reported a patient with borderline intelligence, severe attention deficit-hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism, and sleeping problems in whom all isoforms of the ANK3 gene were disrupted by a balanced translocation.
quotes: In a patient with a borderline intelligence, severe attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism and sleeping problems, all isoforms of the ANK3 gene, were disrupted by a balanced translocation.

findings.statement: Iqbal et al. (2013) found memory defects in a Drosophila knockdown model of the ANK3 ortholog. The authors said this supported the causality of the ANK3 mutations in the 2 families and a role for the gene in cognitive function.
quotes: The causality of ANK3 mutations in the two families and the role of the gene in cognitive function were supported by memory defects in a Drosophila knockdown model.
